title: Incoming Travellers — Kenya Ministry of Health health requirements page
claims: All travellers arriving in Kenya from countries where yellow fever is endemic should present a valid yellow fever certificate.

Listed exemptions from yellow fever vaccination include infants under 9 months (except in high-risk epidemic settings), pregnant women (except high-risk outbreak situations), people with severe allergies to egg protein, and people with severe immunodeficiency due to symptomatic HIV/AIDS or other causes, or thymus disorders.
